title: Bitcoin Technical History
description: A comprehensive map of Bitcoin's consensus evolution, technical breakthroughs, and future proposals.
author: Gemini 3 Flash

nodes.label: Bitcoin Whitepaper
nodes.shortInfo: Satoshi Nakamoto publishes 'Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System'.

sections.heading: The Triple Entry Result
sections.content: Introduced the concept of a Proof-of-Work chain to solve the double-spending problem without a trusted third party.

nodes.label: P2SH (Pay-to-Script-Hash)
nodes.shortInfo: Simplified the use of complex scripts like multi-signature.

sections.heading: Technical Impact
sections.content: Moved the responsibility for supplying the conditions to spend an output from the sender to the redeemer.

nodes.label: CLTV (CheckLockTimeVerify)
nodes.shortInfo: Allows outputs to be unspendable until a specific point in the future.

sections.heading: Time-locking
sections.content: Essential for creating payment channels and atomic swaps by ensuring funds cannot be moved before a timeout.

sections.heading: Relative Locks
sections.content: Enables the clock to start only once a transaction is mined, a prerequisite for the Lightning Network.

nodes.label: Segregated Witness
nodes.shortInfo: Separates witness data, fixes malleability, and increases effective block weight.

sections.heading: Malleability Fix
sections.content: By moving the signature out of the TXID calculation, it allowed for the secure chaining of unconfirmed transactions.

nodes.label: Lightning Network
nodes.shortInfo: Layer 2 scaling solution for instant, low-fee payments.

sections.heading: Off-chain Scaling
sections.content: Uses bidirectional payment channels to route payments across a network of nodes without burdening the base layer.

nodes.label: Taproot
nodes.shortInfo: Schnorr signatures, MAST, and enhanced privacy/efficiency for scripts.

sections.heading: Schnorr Signatures
sections.content: Replaced ECDSA with Schnorr, allowing for key and signature aggregation, making complex spends look like standard ones.

nodes.label: MuSig2
nodes.shortInfo: Multi-signature scheme that is compatible with Taproot.

sections.heading: Aggregation
sections.content: Allows multiple signers to produce a single aggregated signature, saving space and improving privacy.

nodes.label: OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY
nodes.shortInfo: Covenant proposal for scaling, vaults, and congestion control.

sections.heading: Covenants
sections.content: Enables restricting where funds can be sent in future transactions, facilitating cold storage 'vaults'.

nodes.label: Great Script / Simplicity
nodes.shortInfo: Formal verification and high-level language support for Bitcoin scripts.

sections.heading: Formal Safety
sections.content: A typed, combinator-based language designed to make smart contracts easier to analyze and prove correct.

nodes.label: Miniscript
nodes.shortInfo: A language for writing (a subset of) Bitcoin Script in a structured way.

sections.heading: Composability
sections.content: Allows different parties to combine their spending conditions without manual script engineering.
